mapper.sql: c.id,c.run_id AS runId,c.lease_id AS leaseId,c.attempt,c.node_id AS nodeId,c.iteration_id AS iterationId, c.ordinal,c.need_reply AS needReply,c.state,c.request_key AS requestKey,c.request_hash AS requestHash,c.question_json AS questionJson, c.resume_data_json AS resumeDataJson,c.reply_key AS replyKey,c.reply_hash AS replyHash,c.consume_key AS consumeKey,c.consume_hash AS consumeHash, c.revision,c.deadline,c.create_time AS createTime,c.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM paiflow_run_checkpoint c WHERE c.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM paiflow_run_checkpoint c WHERE c.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM paiflow_run_checkpoint c WHERE c.run_id=#{runId} AND c.attempt=#{attempt} AND c.request_key=#{key}
SELECT FROM paiflow_run_checkpoint c WHERE c.run_id=#{runId} AND c.attempt=#{attempt} AND c.node_id=#{nodeId} AND c.iteration_key=COALESCE(#{iterationId},'') AND c.ordinal=#{ordinal}
mapper.update: UPDATE paiflow_run_checkpoint SET state=#{state},resume_data_json=#{resumeDataJson},reply_key=#{replyKey},reply_hash=#{replyHash}, consume_key=#{consumeKey},consume_hash=#{consumeHash},revision=revision+1,update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
